title: Optimal Rerandomization Acceptance Rules for Honest Regression-Adjusted Confidence Width
banked_reason: D-0.5 terminal proposal rejection: repeated C-assumption-impractical after two root repairs; independent validity gate confirms no faithful bounded same-topic repair. Not a mathematical refutation.
gap_reasons: The exact opposing-residual potential-outcome relation is load-bearing for the inverse-N target, yet its justification supplies only constructed tables and explicitly disclaims any realistic or externally supportable setting.

These latent exact cross-world restrictions are instrumental for the sensitivity transfer and regret claim, but the stated justifications establish mathematical nonemptiness rather than credible applicability in an experimental workflow.
proof_attempt_summary: The original diagonal-radius angle exhausted its below-field repairs; a strengthened design-cancellation angle reached a field novelty forecast but repeatedly failed applicability review. Two substantive repairs introduced a bounded local-departure model with robustness modulus and then corrected provenance and conditional framing; neither supplied an externally supportable shrinking cross-world midpoint regime. Independent validity consultation confirmed no bounded same-topic repair under the current contract; this is a terminal proposal rejection, not a mathematical refutation, and no D0 derivation or Lean formalization was completed.
tldr: At a public rerandomization acceptance probability, central covariate balance uniquely minimizes honest worst expected confidence width for a prescribed interacted-OLS ATE center at the diagonal zero-departure cancellation anchor. The optimized radius uses one conditional folded-normal branch, one product cutoff and one multiplier. Bounded local common-residual departures and a quantitative score-covariance neighborhood receive explicit coverage inflation and design-regret bounds, with uniformly honest assigned-record transfer. Exact design optimality is confined to the anchor. Gaussian confidence methods and the Kabaila--Giri observation embedding are credited; the contribution is the confidence-loss assignment optimum and its robust randomization transfer. This is a purely conditional mathematical benchmark for choosing balance criteria in a regression-adjusted ATE workflow; scientific application requires external justification of its cross-world local sensitivity class.
gap: Variance-optimal symmetric acceptance and conditional-bias acceptance are established. The missing decision object is the assignment law minimizing an endogenous coverage-constrained radius for a prescribed fitted OLS center at the cancellation scale, with an honest local-departure sensitivity calculation.
fill: Theorem 3 gives a global anchor certificate and equality conditions; Theorem 4 gives explicit local-departure coverage and regret moduli; Theorems 1 and 5 derive and transfer the enlarged experiment under assignment randomness alone. Theorem 7 evaluates complete randomization and the representable scalar variance- and bias-optimal criteria on the same confidence loss; selector compactness and accepted-law closure are explicit proof obligations.
